note.zh-TW: 故事第 16 筆的存貨盤盈預設不放這一列，屬推論（T06）。
note.en: The inventory count surplus in step 16 of the story is by default not placed here; that is an inference (T06).

definition.zh-TW: 教材損益表裡放少見、不會經常發生的利益的一列。現行報表沒有這一列；本課的故事也沒有用到。
definition.en: A line in the course income statement for rare, non-recurring gains. Current statements have no such line and the course story does not use it.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IAS 1.87 禁止在損益表或附註把任何收益或費損列為非常項目；改用 IFRS 時這類項目併入營業外收支或其他利益及損失，稅前淨利不變。
ifrsNote.en: IAS 1.87 prohibits presenting any item of income or expense as extraordinary. Under IFRS such items are included in non-operating or other gains and losses, and profit before tax is unchanged.
